findings.description: Removing the custom __reduce_ex__ means pickling a Sentinel member now uses Enum's default reduction, which pickles the internal object() value and rebuilds the member by value.
findings.rationale: Under the trigger of pickling UNSET or FLAG_NEEDS_VALUE (for example, a pickled Click parameter or context that holds the sentinel as a default), the default reduction serializes a fresh object() as the value. On unpickling, Sentinel(value) looks up a value that does not match the singleton's identity and raises ValueError, or yields a member that no longer compares identical to UNSET, so the identity checks used throughout Click fail. The impact is a crash or silently broken sentinel comparisons after a pickle round-trip.
